scope: Current useNetworkStatus hook executed with memory storage; App/NetworkStatusIndicator rendering conditions reviewed. No browser/Firebase.

finding.trigger: An old offline queue contains an entry without ownerId; another staff account, including HR Manager, opens Network & Synchronization Status.
finding.impact: Legacy PO details remain visible across accounts even when the account cannot open PO. Unowned entries cannot auto-sync, so this is display isolation, not a write authorization bypass.
finding.limitation: Requires preexisting legacy queue without ownerId. New enqueue operations always attach an owner.
